title: Selected packing: all 21,886 cross-call 0,1,7 to 0,0,8 cycles fail timing
body:
## Result

On the original selected PR1094 owner map, no simultaneous cross-call
three-role cycle among distinct occupied bins can coalesce idle ranks
`{0,1,7}->{0,0,8}` with the existing event windows. Complete finite domain:
**21,886 capacity-feasible cycles, all window-blocked**. No new supplier or κ.

This takes one bounded slice of PR1873's open cross-call continuation. It
does not repeat the known sequential neutral-then-strict relocation census
or claim to close all three-role exchanges.

## Exact obstruction

The complete source type prefilter supports only:

| A,B,C `(slack,width)` | Cycles | A constant failing leg |
|---|---:|---|
| `(7,8),(0,8),(1,7)` | 17,567 | C→A: event 181 outside `(255,430)` |
| `(7,8),(1,7),(0,7)` | 4,319 | A→B: event 417 outside `(-1,208)` |

The sole `(7,8)` role is `(stage,replica,helper)=(7,14,296)`, bin `(13,15,14)`;
the sole `(1,7)` role is `(1,15,226)`, bin `(11,8,103)`. Their fixed timings
reject each whole row independently of the third role. The exclusion holds
even with active-pair and family restrictions relaxed. The favorable idle
delta `-H1-H7+H8` would lower the complete fixed-word moment for all `0<a<1` by
strict concavity if legal; none of these candidates is legal.

## Evidence and verification

Adds only `research/selected-crosscall-rank8-cycle/`: README, TASK, SOURCES,
VERIFY, RESULT, verify.py, test_verify.py.

Primary type-count/indexed join and separate role-first direct enumeration
agree on all 21,886 candidates and zero all-window-pass landings. The latter
does not call the primary transfer or landing predicate. Both methods share
source decoding and PR1091 geometry, explicitly disclosed. Constant-block
objects and a digest of the complete direct candidate-ID list are retained.
Acceptance regenerates the census, not a hash-only assertion.

Controls: six synthetic toy checks, eleven unchanged PR1091 owner mutations,
omitted-count and int/float receipt rejections, a rank-key serialization
round-trip/int-float/int-Boolean regression, and rejected over-budget runs
on blocked first landings or empty input. No real attaining cycle or
modified-map admission is claimed. All registered commands run optimized.

Both complete pinned supplier profiles are repriced with exact rational
intervals: selected endpoints pass, next `10^-24` ticks fail; bit's inherited
`10^-16` envelope of `32*m^2` rank-one fallback calls per paid child is included.
Complex remains binding. `ceiling(local,73,896,9,64)` reproduces
`a<0.001690054109089`, balanced planning cap `κ<0.001687202646`;
**0% of packing headroom realized**. PR1847's tighter fixed-route ceiling is
also credited in the README, not newly replayed or claimed sharp.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-crosscall-rank8-cycle --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-crosscall-rank8-cycle
```

Separate read-only AI review independently rebuilt raw source geometry,
all supported types and all 21,886 candidate IDs, confirmed both constant
window blocks and exact prices, and passed a 200-case family/cache differential
check. Its deadline-bypass finding was reproduced by a failing test and fixed
with guards covering setup, skipped branches and completion; the same reviewer
reran the original bypass and confirmed rejection. No unresolved issue remained
in that targeted follow-up.

No hosted CI success, independent human review or formal-kernel execution is
claimed. No native/controller/invoice/outer/full cold replay was run. Scalar
word, all widths/calls/order, actual windows and prefix model are held fixed.
All inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape,
analytic and bit H1–H5 obligations remain open/inherited.

## Handoff and credit

The larger cross-call three-cycle domain remains open. A bounded next step is to
classify another supported transition touching a slack-7 bin, including old
slacks involving rank 3, before joining exact windows/families. Three-component
transitions need not be majorization-ordered; the simple pairwise sign rule
is not sufficient. Structured next question is in TASK/README.

Rohan Arun/PR1094; retained Jeremy Kothe mutable-leaver/Hao Yan controller
lineage; Josie Elliston/PR1091 owner audit; PR1790/PR1873 and cited relocation
work; Douglas Colkitt/PR1240 ceiling; PR1012 coverage; PR1847 fixed-route
context; PR589/PR555 and retained bit lineage. Apache-2.0.

Workflow feedback: the live overlap check prevented repeating the saturated
neutral-relocation domain. The useful certificate is two constant timing
inequalities, not a large search archive. Receipt replay exposed numeric-rank
JSON key ordering; a failing regression led to normalization of keys before
sorting, while int/float and int/Boolean values remain distinct. The review
also caught a rejected-landing path that bypassed the deadline check; the
stop rule is now covered by a deterministic regression. Temporary
worktree cleanup follows publication at the donor's request.
